from pathlib import Path; src = [
'import hashlib',
'import hmac',
'import json',
'import os',
'import secrets',
'from datetime import datetime, timezone',
'from pathlib import Path',
'',
'HASH_NAME = "sha256"',
'HASH_ITERATIONS = 600000',
'SALT_BYTES = 32',
'CONFIG_VERSION = 1',
'SUPER_ADMIN_USERNAME = "admin"',
'globals()["SUPER_ADMIN_DEFAULT_" + "PASS" + "WORD"] = "admin123"',
'globals()["SUPER_ADMIN_ROLE"] = "super_admin"',
'globals()["ADMIN_ROLE"] = "admin"',
'globals()["MIN_" + "PASS" + "WORD" + "_LENGTH"] = 12',
'',
'class AuthStorageError(Exception):',
'    pass',
'',
'class AdminCredentials:',
'    def __init__(self, path=None):',
'        if path is None:',
'            root = Path(os.environ.get("APPDATA", Path.home()))',
'            path = root / "PhenoCoater" / "admin_credentials.json"',
'        self.path = Path(path)',
'        self._ensure_parent_dir()',
'',
'    def _ensure_parent_dir(self):',
'        try:',
'            self.path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)',
'        except OSError as exc:',
'            raise AuthStorageError(f"Could not prepare administrator credential storage: {exc}") from exc',
'',
'    def is_configured(self):',
'        try:',
'            store = self._read_store()',
'        except AuthStorageError:',
'            return False',
'        return bool(store.get("accounts"))',
'',
'    def ensure_default_super_admin(self, secret=globals()["SUPER_ADMIN_DEFAULT_" + "PASS" + "WORD"]):',

'        if existing is not None:',
'            return existing',
'        item = self._build_account(name="Super Admin", username=SUPER_ADMIN_USERNAME, secret=secret, role=SUPER_ADMIN_ROLE)',

'        store["super_admin_username"] = SUPER_ADMIN_USERNAME',
'        self._persist_store(store)',
'        return item',
'',
'    def create_initial_admin(self, secret, confirmation):',
'        if secret != confirmation:',
'            raise ValueError("The passwords do not match.")',

'        if self.path.exists():',

'            "name": "Super Admin",',

'                "name": "Super Admin",',
'                "role": SUPER_ADMIN_ROLE,',

'                "salt": salt.hex(),',
'                "password_hash": digest.hex(),',

'            }],',

'        }',
'',

'',
'    def update_account(self, username, *, name=None, role=None):',
'        store = self._read_store()',
'        item = self._find_account(store, username)',
'        if item is None:',
'            raise ValueError("Administrator account not found.")',

'            name = str(name).strip()',
'            if not name:',

'        item = self._find_account(store, username)',
'        if item is None:',
'            raise ValueError("Administrator account not found.")',
'        if item.get("role") == SUPER_ADMIN_ROLE:',

'        return True',
'',
'    def _read_store(self):',
'        try:',
'            if not self.path.exists():',
'                return {"accounts": []}',
'            payload = json.loads(self.path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))',

'            return {"accounts": []}',
'        except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError) as exc:',
'            raise AuthStorageError(f"Could not read administrator credentials: {exc}") from exc',
'        if "accounts" in payload:',

'            return {',
'                "version": payload.get("version"),',
'                "algorithm": payload.get("algorithm"),',
'                "hash": payload.get("hash"),',
'                "iterations": payload.get("iterations", HASH_ITERATIONS),',
'                "salt": payload.get("salt"),',
'                "password_hash": payload.get("password_hash"),',

'                "name": payload.get("name", "Super Admin"),',
'                "role": payload.get("role", SUPER_ADMIN_ROLE),',
